eval_benchmarks: Global-MMLU, MMMLU, INCLUDE, XNLI, MGSM, IrokoBench, FLORES-200, Belebele, FLEURS
cldr_coverage: 3 modern, 2 moderate, 1 basic, 0 not in CLDR
reach_text_share: Speakers who use the internet and can read and write text on a phone. Weighted by speakers in 72 countries: US, IN, PK, NG, PH, GB, TZ, CA…
reach_text_share_5y: Projected internet use, 5 years ahead, times today's ability to text. Weighted by speakers in 72 countries: US, IN, PK, NG, PH, GB, TZ, CA…
reach_voice_share: Speakers who use the internet. Weighted by speakers in 72 countries: US, IN, PK, NG, PH, GB, TZ, CA…
reach_voice_share_5y: Internet use projected 5 years ahead on its recent trend. Weighted by speakers in 72 countries: US, IN, PK, NG, PH, GB, TZ, CA…
speaker_growth_5y: Population growth over 5 years. Weighted by speakers in 72 countries: US, IN, PK, NG, PH, GB, TZ, CA…
web_text_words: English is not in FineWeb-2; FineWeb (English) holds ~15T tokens. Recorded at a nominal 1T words, above the goalpost maximum.
llm_mmmlu_openai: English: the original MMLU, which MMMLU translates
parallel_sentences: English is the pivot; recorded at a nominal value
open_speech_hours: Multilingual LibriSpeech 44,660, YODAS 41,400, Common Voice 2,827, FLEURS 12
speech_fleurs: About 12 hours per language; CC BY 4.0
speech_yodas: Video hours with manually uploaded subtitles; CC BY 3.0
asr_whisper_fleurs_wer: Word error rate (character error rate for Chinese, Japanese, Korean, Thai)
wikipedia_active_editors: Registered users with an edit in the last 30 days
asr_azure_features: Counts real-time, batch, fast transcription, mono- and multilingual refinement, LLM speech, MAI-Transcribe, custom speech with labeled audio, custom pronunciation, display format

kb_apple_features: Has: Autocorrection, Predictive typing, Multilingual typing, QuickPath

tts_azure: Read from a third-party copy of Azure's voice list; Microsoft's page loads the table separately
